header.description: What: on berlin a stochastic 'Blue Stochastic Platoon' (30 men) marches 800 m east under the generic Move play. The check CUTS its route four times - at 10, 20, 30 and 40 s the follower's state is set to RouteFailed (the planner dropped the route). Judge: the play re-requests the route after each of the first three cuts (the unit is OnRoute again) and, at the fourth (more than the 3 re-requests R-8308 allows), gives up: the unit stays RouteFailed and the company hears PROGRESS TaskFailed. Fail: a fourth re-request, or no TaskFailed. Check: scripts/scenario-regression.sh agg-route-dropped
